definitions.explanation: A shop that sells fresh meat.
A person who sells meat at a shop.

examples.japanese: {肉屋|にくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought it at the butcher shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉屋|にくや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The butcher shop in front of the station is famous for its croquettes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉屋|にくや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are still old-fashioned butcher shops remaining in this area.

examples.japanese: {肉屋|にくや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おじさん→おじさん：00803_ojisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧だ。
{肉屋|にくや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧にして⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the butcher slice it thin.

examples.japanese: {肉屋|にくや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}したら→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧、⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ロース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: When I asked the butcher, he recommended chuck roll for sukiyaki.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/person). The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ can refer to both the shop and the shopkeeper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉屋|にくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a butcher shop
- {肉屋|にくや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧: butcher shop croquettes (a classic Japanese takeaway item)
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉屋|にくや}: neighborhood butcher shop

CULTURE: Traditional {肉屋|にくや} in Japan often sell ready-made fried items like croquettes (⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧) and ⟦{串|くし}カツ→串カツ：11354_kushikatsu⟧ alongside raw meat. Many neighborhoods still have independent butcher shops, though supermarkets have become the primary place to buy meat.
